aboutPageTitle: About VocalWitness • Truth • Evidence • Public Square
aboutSubtitle: Your Voice. Your Truth. Protected by Design.
missionPara1: VocalWitness is a simple public square where anyone can share what they saw or experienced — with proof that it hasn’t been changed.
missionPara2: In a world full of edited videos, fake news and controlled narratives, we give ordinary people a safe place to publish raw testimonies, photos, voice notes and documents. Everything is protected with strong cryptography so the evidence stays trustworthy and your privacy stays intact.
forensicIntegrityDesc: Every photo, voice note and document is given a unique digital fingerprint (SHA-256 hash) right on your device before it is uploaded. Zero-Knowledge proofs let others confirm the evidence is real without seeing your private details.
privacyFirstDesc: Speaking out is always your choice. We automatically remove camera location and device information. Phone verification is only temporary — used to stop spam bots — and is never stored on any public record.
communityStewardshipDesc: No single person or company decides what is true. Trust grows through honest participation, transparent reputation scores, and community tools. We stay neutral.
communitySupportedDesc: VocalWitness is kept alive by voluntary community support and crypto donations. There are no ads, no paywalls and no premium features locked behind payment.
trustStep1Desc: Everyone begins as a Citizen. You can raise your verification level with simple anti-bot checks and good behaviour. Higher levels unlock stronger cryptographic protection (True Witness mode).
trustStep2Desc: Once something is published, it is timestamped and locked into a permanent chain. No one — not even us — can quietly change or delete the original record.
trustStep3Desc: VocalWitness is a neutral public square. We do not edit posts, shadow-ban people, or push certain stories higher. The evidence speaks for itself.
aboutQuote: "In the age of noise, the clearest voice is the one that can prove it was never altered."
footerCopyright: © 2026 VocalWitness • Built for Truth • Evidence • Public Square
privacySubtitle: Your privacy is protected by strong technology — not just promises.
zkSubpoenaTitle: We Cannot Give What We Do Not Have
zkSubpoenaDesc: VocalWitness is built so that your personal identity never reaches our servers. If any court, government, or authority asks us for your private information, our answer is simple and mathematical: We have nothing to give. Zero personal identity logs exist.
privacySec1Title: 1. Everything Important Happens on Your Device
privacySec1Para1: When you upload a photo, voice note, or document, the sensitive work is done inside your own browser before anything leaves your device:
privacySec1Bullet1: Metadata is removed: Camera model, GPS location, and other private details are automatically stripped.
privacySec1Bullet2: Digital fingerprint is created: Your browser makes a unique SHA-256 hash (like a fingerprint) of the file. Only this fingerprint and the cleaned media are sent.
privacySec1Bullet3: Zero-Knowledge proofs: You can prove you are a real verified person without revealing your private identity details.
privacySec2Title: 2. What We Never Collect or Store
privacySec2Intro: For maximum safety (especially for people in high-risk situations), we deliberately do not keep:
privacySec2Item1: Your real IP address — requests go through Cloudflare so your original location is not linked to your posts.
privacySec2Item2: Phone numbers on any public record — phone checks are only temporary to stop spam bots and are never saved or shown.
privacySec2Item3: Government IDs, passports, biometrics, or your personal contact list.
privacySec3Title: 3. What We Do Process (Only What’s Needed)
privacyAccountInfoDesc: Your chosen username, browser security keys, and any trust badges you earn.
privacyContentDesc: Your testimonies, cleaned media, digital fingerprints (hashes), and timestamps.
privacyVerificationDesc: Proof that you are a real person — without revealing who you are.
privacyTechnicalDesc: Anonymous technical data used only to block attacks and bots (via Cloudflare and Firebase).
privacySec4Text: Our design follows Articles 12 and 19 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights: everyone has the right to privacy and the freedom to share information without interference, no matter where they live.
privacySec5Text1: VocalWitness is only a technical host. We do not write, approve, or fact-check the content people post.
privacySec5Text2: Each person is fully responsible for what they choose to publish. We are not liable for user content.
privacySec6Title: 6. What Is Not Allowed & How to Report
privacySec6Text1: Harassment, sharing someone’s private personal details without consent, child sexual abuse material, and deliberately fake harmful media are strictly forbidden.
privacySec6Text2: If you see content that breaks these rules or exposes private information, please report it using the in-app button. Valid reports will be reviewed and the content can be hidden or restricted.
privacySec7Text: You can instantly clear your local browser data with the red Quick Exit button. However, once a testimony is published and locked into the public ledger, it becomes a permanent historical record and cannot be quietly changed or deleted.
privacySec8Text: The VocalWitness platform, including its software, cryptographic systems, hashing methods, Zero-Knowledge technology implementation, Evidence Ledger design, interface, branding, name, and logo, is the exclusive intellectual property of VocalWitness. These elements are protected by copyright and applicable intellectual property laws. You may not copy, reverse-engineer, or reuse any part of the platform’s technology or methods without explicit written permission.
termsIntro: Welcome to VocalWitness — a public square where people can share real testimonies and evidence with strong protection. By using the platform you agree to these simple rules.
termsSection1Text: By creating an account, posting, or using VocalWitness in any way, you agree to these Terms and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.
termsSection2Title: 2. Our Role – A Neutral Public Square
termsSection2Text: VocalWitness is a neutral platform. We give people tools to publish testimonies and protect evidence with cryptography. We are not a news publisher, we do not decide what is true, and we are not a court of law.
termsSection3Intro: To keep the square safe from bots and spam, we use simple levels of verification:
termsTier1: Citizen Talk — Open to everyone who signs up. Basic public discussion.
termsTier2: Trust Circle — Unlocked with a temporary phone check (used only to stop spam). Your phone number is never saved on the public ledger.
termsTier3: Witness Voice / True Witness — Highest level. Your media gets a digital fingerprint (SHA-256 hash) on your own device, private details are removed, and Zero-Knowledge proofs help prove the evidence is real without revealing your identity.
termsSection4Intro: You stay in control of your voice. Here are the clear rules:
termsConduct1: Your Choice: You decide whether to speak publicly or stay more private. Attaching your real name is always voluntary.
termsConduct2: Be Honest: Only post testimonies and evidence you genuinely believe are true and authentic.
termsConduct3: No Doxxing or Harassment: Do not share other people’s private contact details, home addresses, or banking information. Targeted harassment is not allowed.
termsConduct4: No Fake or Harmful Content: Creating deepfakes to harm someone, or spreading malware, is strictly forbidden.
termsSection5Text: You keep full ownership of everything you post. By publishing, you give VocalWitness permission to store, display, and protect your content on the public ledger. Once something is notarized, it becomes part of a permanent record and cannot be quietly changed later.
termsSection6Text: We use trusted global services (Google Cloud / Firebase for secure storage and Cloudflare for protection against attacks). The platform is provided “as is” — we work hard to keep it reliable, but we cannot guarantee it will never have downtime.
termsSection7Text: The platform is supported by voluntary donations and community contributions (including crypto). Donations are non-refundable and do not give anyone special control, immunity, or ownership of the platform.
termsSection8Text: To the fullest extent allowed by law, VocalWitness and its operators are not responsible for any indirect or consequential damages that may arise from using the platform, from content posted by users, or from temporary service interruptions.
termsSection9Title: 9. Your Responsibility for What You Post
termsSection9Text: You agree to protect VocalWitness from any legal claims that arise because you broke these rules or posted illegal, defamatory, or infringing material. If someone has a problem with content, they should use our official reporting and takedown process instead of targeting the platform operators directly.
termsSection10Text: All rights, title, and interest in and to the VocalWitness platform — including its software, source code, design, user interface, cryptographic methods, hashing systems, Zero-Knowledge verification processes, Evidence Ledger architecture, branding, name, logo, and all related materials — are and shall remain the exclusive property of VocalWitness and its rightful owners.
termsSection10Text2: You may not copy, reverse-engineer, modify, distribute, sell, create derivative works from, or commercially exploit any part of the platform or its underlying methods without prior written permission from VocalWitness. Unauthorized use may result in legal action.
divineNaturalLawTitle: Your Right to Speak the Truth
divineNaturalLawDesc: Every person has a natural right to share what they have witnessed. This right is protected worldwide under Article 19 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights — the freedom to hold opinions and to share information without interference, no matter where you live.
subpoenaDefenseDesc: We cannot give away information that we never collected. VocalWitness uses local hashing and zero-knowledge technology so your identity stays protected.
subpoenaDefenseBullet1: No identity logs: We do not store your IP address with your public posts.
subpoenaDefenseBullet2: Automatic cleaning: Camera details and GPS location are removed in your browser before anything is uploaded.
subpoenaDefenseBullet3: Mathematical protection: Even if authorities ask, we have no private keys or hidden data that can unmask anonymous witnesses.
opsecProtocolTitle: 2. Extra Safety Tips for High-Risk Situations
networkSafetySubDesc: When you are in a restrictive area, use Tor or a trusted VPN. Avoid publishing on mobile networks that are directly linked to your government-issued SIM card.
physicalSafetySubDesc: Protect your phone with a strong passcode (not just fingerprint or face unlock). If you feel in danger, press the red Quick Exit button — it immediately clears local data and leaves the site.
safetyProhibitIntro: To keep the platform safe and credible for everyone, these actions are strictly forbidden:
safetyProhibit1: Doxxing: Sharing someone’s private phone number, home address, or ID details without their clear permission.
safetyProhibit2: Harassment & Threats: Intimidating people, encouraging violence, or making personal attacks.
safetyProhibit3: Fake or Altered Evidence: Uploading deepfakes or edited media meant to falsely accuse or harm others.
safetyProhibit4: Spam & Fake Accounts: Using bots or many fake accounts to manipulate the community.
safetySection4Title: 4. How We Keep the Community Safe
safetySection4Text: Safety comes from community reporting, automatic checks for harmful language, and clear verification levels:
safetyModTier1: Citizen Talk — Open discussion for everyone.
safetyModTier2: True Witness — Higher-trust level with cryptographically protected evidence and reputation scores.
safetyGoalText: A safe public square where real testimonies can be shared, people are protected by design, and technology helps truth travel freely.
ledgerIntegrityPara1: Once a record is written to the Forensic Ledger or the audit log, the application and database rules make it impossible for any user (or ordinary operator) to edit or delete it.
ledgerIntegrityPoint1: Firestore security rules explicitly forbid update and delete on the ledger collections.
ledgerIntegrityPoint2: Client-side SHA-256 hashing of media and content.
ledgerIntegrityPoint3: Hash-chaining of audit entries (each entry contains the cryptographic hash of the previous one).
ledgerIntegrityClarification: Important clarification: This is application-level immutability. It is not a full public blockchain. The data lives in Firebase / Google Cloud. The rules and cryptography make silent changes extremely difficult, but the ultimate trust still rests on the operator’s honesty and the cloud provider’s integrity.
ledgerIntegrityFuture: Planned optional strengthening: periodic cryptographic hashes of the ledger can be exported and pinned to IPFS and/or lightly anchored on a public chain. This is not yet active.
